<reason>PRO won the central control and compensation clash. CON's rider-only theory was turned by its own support for account bans, and PRO narrowed to a knowable failure - ignoring required suspension - that needs no perfect GPS and still requires proof of contribution. CON's permit-only alternative never solved the uncompensated victim when the rider cannot pay, while PRO showed fines punish disobedience but do not compensate.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's use of CON's clear-triggers account bans to show prevention is shared, then exposing the inconsistency of calling triggers clear for a city fine but unknowably vague for victim compensation.</best_rebuttal>
